1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 Bc5 4.O-O Nd4 5..strategy: A gambit that offers the b-pawn to pull the bishop away from c5, the square from which it guards the knight on d4. Black can simply take the pawn, so White has to prove the activity is worth it; the quiet exchange on d4 asks far less of White.
1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 Bc5 4.O-O Nd4 5..name: Ruy Lopez: Classical Defence, Zaitsev Variation
